scope: Authorized publication of resource catalogue, three category forms and five cross-linked opening discussions; no model execution or package release.

categories.name: Announcements
categories.description: Maintainer updates on PeptideMT releases, development and compatibility.

categories.name: Datasets and Benchmarks
categories.description: Collect and discuss peptide databases, datasets and evaluation benchmarks. Examine provenance, experimental context, coverage, data leakage and reproducibility.

categories.name: Ideas
categories.description: Early ideas for PeptideMT. Concrete proposals and decisions go to issues or versioned records.

categories.name: Q&A
categories.description: Questions about using PeptideMT. Actionable findings go to owning issues.

categories.name: Reading List
categories.description: Discuss papers and reviews that inform peptide research and PeptideMT development. Explain their relevance, main findings, limitations and open questions.

categories.name: Tools and Models
categories.description: Discover and compare peptide-design tools, predictors and generative models. Discuss capabilities, availability, licences, evidence and limitations.

discussions.title: Tools and models — catalogue and discovery
AMP — generators, predictors and evaluation resources
CPP — tools, evidence and research questions
Datasets and benchmarks — catalogue and evaluation questions
Reading list — papers and scientific questions
